```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)


gene_expression <- read.csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv")
gene_names<- read.csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")
participant_information<-read.csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")


# Check if sample IDs match
sum(colnames(gene_expression)[-1] %in% participant_information$geoID)

# Check if probe IDs match gene names
sum(gene_expression$X %in% gene_names$PROBEID)

#  only samples that have matching participant information
matched_ids <- intersect(
  colnames(gene_expression)[-1],
  participant_information$geoID
)

# Select those samples and keep the probe ID column
expression_matched <- gene_expression[
  , c("X", matched_ids)
]

# Keep participant records in the same order as the expression samples
participant_matched <- participant_information[
  match(matched_ids, participant_information$geoID),
]

# Confirm the sample IDs are now in the same order
all(colnames(expression_matched)[-1] == participant_matched$geoID)

# Add the gene names to the expression data using probe IDs
gene_expression_named <- merge(
  gene_names,
  expression_matched,
  by.x = "PROBEID",
  by.y = "X"
)

# Check the result
head(gene_expression_named[, 1:3])

il24_row <- gene_expression_named[
  gene_expression_named$GENE == "IL24",
]

il24_row

# Select IL24 gene expression
il24_data <- gene_expression_named %>%
  filter(GENE == "IL24")

# Convert gene expression data to long format
il24_long <- il24_data %>%
  select(-PROBEID, -GENE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "geoID",
    values_to = "IL24_expression"
  )

# Match IL24 expression to participant information
il24_analysis <- il24_long %>%
  left_join(participant_matched, by = "geoID")

# Check the data
head(il24_analysis)
nrow(il24_analysis)


plot1 <- ggplot(il24_analysis, aes(x = IL24_expression)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 20,
    fill = "#8AB9B0",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of IL24 Gene Expression",
    x = "IL24 Gene Expression",
    y = "Number of Participants"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black")
  )

print(plot1)



# PLOT 2: SCATTERPLOT
# IL24 Gene Expression vs. Maternal Age
# Convert maternal age to numeric
il24_analysis$mat_age_yrs <- as.numeric(
  sub(".*: ", "", as.character(il24_analysis$mat_age_yrs))
)

# Check the result
str(il24_analysis$mat_age_yrs)
summary(il24_analysis$mat_age_yrs)

plot2 <- ggplot(
  il24_analysis,
  aes(x = mat_age_yrs, y = IL24_expression)
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.65,
    color = "#C06C84",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "#765285",
    fill = "#D9C2E9",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IL24 Gene Expression by Maternal Age",
    x = "Maternal Age (years)",
    y = "IL24 Gene Expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black")
  )

print(plot2)




# PLOT 3: BOXPLOT
# IL24 Expression by Preeclampsia Status and BMI

# Extract the numeric BMI values from the original text
# Make the grouping variables easier to interpret
# PLOT 3: IL24 Expression by Preeclampsia Status and BMI

# Step 1: Convert BMI to numeric and create BMI categories
il24_analysis <- il24_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    mat_BMI = as.numeric(
      sub(".*: ", "", as.character(mat_BMI))
    ),
    BMI_category = cut(
      mat_BMI,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 18.5, 25, 30, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "Underweight",
        "Normal weight",
        "Overweight",
        "Obesity"
      ),
      right = FALSE
    )
  )

# Step 2: Set category order
il24_analysis <- il24_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    preg_preeclampsia = factor(preg_preeclampsia),
    BMI_category = factor(
      BMI_category,
      levels = c(
        "Underweight",
        "Normal weight",
        "Overweight",
        "Obesity"
      )
    )
  )

# Step 3: Check sample sizes
table(
  il24_analysis$preg_preeclampsia,
  il24_analysis$BMI_category,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# Step 4: Create boxplot with jittered individual observations
plot3 <- ggplot(
  il24_analysis,
  aes(
    x = preg_preeclampsia,
    y = IL24_expression,
    fill = BMI_category
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    color = "#51445F",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.75,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = BMI_category),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      dodge.width = 0.8
    ),
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 1.5,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Underweight" = "#B8A1D9",
      "Normal weight" = "#E8A0BF",
      "Overweight" = "#E9B872",
      "Obesity" = "#8AB9B0"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Underweight" = "#8065A8",
      "Normal weight" = "#B85F85",
      "Overweight" = "#B27A32",
      "Obesity" = "#4D8278"
    ),
    guide = "none",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IL24 Expression by Preeclampsia Status and BMI",
    x = "Pregnancy Outcome",
    y = "IL24 Gene Expression",
    fill = "Maternal BMI Category"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

# Step 5: Display plot
print(plot3)
```
```{r}
selected_genes <- c("ABCA9", "ABCB7")



participant_plot_data <- participant_matched %>%
  mutate(
    mat_age_yrs = as.numeric(
      sub(".*: ", "", as.character(mat_age_yrs))
    ),
    mat_BMI = as.numeric(
      sub(".*: ", "", as.character(mat_BMI))
    ),
    preg_preeclampsia = as.factor(preg_preeclampsia),
    BMI_category = case_when(
      is.na(mat_BMI) ~ NA_character_,
      mat_BMI < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
      mat_BMI < 25 ~ "Normal weight",
      mat_BMI < 30 ~ "Overweight",
      mat_BMI >= 30 ~ "Obese"
    )
  )

# Generate three plots for each selected gene
for (gene_name in selected_genes) {

  # Extract expression data and attach participant information
  gene_data <- gene_expression_named %>%
    filter(GENE == gene_name) %>%
    select(-PROBEID, -GENE) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "geoID",
      values_to = "expression"
    ) %>%
    mutate(expression = as.numeric(as.character(expression))) %>%
    left_join(participant_plot_data, by = "geoID")

  # Stop with a clear message if the gene is absent
  if (nrow(gene_data) == 0) {
    message("Gene ", gene_name, " was not found in gene_expression_named.")
    next
  }

  # 1. Histogram: distribution of gene expression
  p1 <- ggplot(gene_data, aes(x = expression)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", gene_name, "Expression"),
      x = "Gene Expression",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p1)

  # 2. Scatterplot: gene expression vs maternal age
  p2 <- ggplot(
    gene_data,
    aes(x = mat_age_yrs, y = expression)
  ) +
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = paste(gene_name, "Expression vs Maternal Age"),
      x = "Maternal Age (years)",
      y = "Gene Expression"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p2)

  # 3. Boxplot: gene expression by preeclampsia status and BMI category
  p3 <- ggplot(
    gene_data,
    aes(
      x = preg_preeclampsia,
      y = expression,
      fill = BMI_category
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = paste(gene_name, "Expression by Preeclampsia and BMI"),
      x = "Preeclampsia Status",
      y = "Gene Expression",
      fill = "BMI Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p3)
}




```
